title: Now is the best time to
titleEn: Using Now is the best time to for timely action

source.file: Sentence Structure 163 -「Now is the best time to.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Now + is + the best time + to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Now + is + the best time + to + base verb + other information

example: Now is the best time to study.
exampleZh: 現在是讀書的最佳時機。

examples.en: Now is the best time to study.
examples.zh: 現在是讀書的最佳時機。
examples.highlight: Now is the best time to study.

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，best 是形容詞，用來形容名詞 time。 因此，完整句型並不是 Now is the best + adjective + to...，而是： Now is the best time to + 動詞原形
rules.en: The complete pattern is “Now is the best time to + base verb”. In this structure, best is an adjective describing the noun time. Write Now is the best time to study, not Now is the best to study.
examples: In this structure, best is an adjective describing the noun time.

rules.zh: 在 to 後面必須使用動詞原形。
rules.en: Use the base form after “to” Correct： Now is the best time to start. Incorrect： Now is the best time to starting. Incorrect： Now is the best time to started.

rules.zh: Now 不一定只表示「這一秒」，也可以表示今天、這星期、現階段或目前的情況。
rules.en: “Now” does not always mean this exact second. It may refer to this moment, today, this week, the present stage or the current situation.

rules.zh: 這個句型的語氣比「你現在可以做」更強。它表示現在不只是可以做，而是最適合做的時機。
rules.en: Use this structure only when the present is especially suitable This structure is stronger than simply saying: You can do it now. It means that the present is the most suitable time.
examples: It means that the present is the most suitable time.

rules.zh: （現在並不是討論這件事的最佳時機。）
rules.en: This exercise practises the positive form This worksheet practises: Now is the best time to... The negative form below is grammatical, but it is not the target of this exercise: Now is not the best time to discuss this.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能立即突出「現在」的重要性，讓聽者明白不應錯過目前的時機。
benefits.en: It clearly emphasises timing This structure immediately tells the listener that the present time is especially important or suitable.

benefits.zh: （現在開始儲蓄。） （現在是開始儲蓄的最佳時機。） 第二句同樣能提出明確建議，但語氣不像命令般直接，較容易讓別人接受。
benefits.en: It gives advice without sounding like a direct order Compare: Start saving money now. Now is the best time to start saving money. The second sentence still gives strong advice, but it sounds less like a command.
examples: The second sentence still gives strong advice, but it sounds less like a command.

benefits.zh: 你可以把「現在最適合」和「應該做甚麼」合併成一句，令表達更簡潔。
benefits.en: It combines timing and action in one sentence Instead of writing: You should begin now. This is the most suitable time. You can write: Now is the best time to begin.
examples: You should begin now. This is the most suitable time.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用來鼓勵別人開始計劃、解決問題、作出改變、把握機會，或及時採取行動。
benefits.en: It is useful for persuasion You can use this structure when encouraging someone to: begin a plan； solve a problem； make a change； take advantage of an opportunity； act before it is too late.
examples: act before it is too late.

benefits.zh: 記住這個固定框架後，你可以在說話時快速加入不同動作，更容易組織完整答案。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame Once you remember: Now is the best time to... you can quickly add your own action: Now is the best time to ask. Now is the best time to prepare. Now is the best time to make a change.
examples: Now is the best time to ask.
Now is the best time to prepare.
Now is the best time to make a change.

questions.answer: Now is the best time to give small businesses clearer guidance on the new application process.
questions.answerZh: 現在是就新申請程序向小型企業提供更清晰指引的最佳時機。
questions.highlight: Now is the best time to give small businesses clearer guidance on the new application process.

questions.prompt: All the evidence is now available, but no final judgement has been made. This is the ideal point for reviewing it carefully.
questions.promptZh: 所有證據現已齊備，但尚未作出最終判斷。現在是仔細審視證據的理想時候。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to review the evidence carefully before making a final judgement.
questions.answerZh: 現在是在作出最終判斷前仔細審視證據的最佳時機。
questions.highlight: Now is the best time to review the evidence carefully before making a final judgement.

questions.prompt: Passenger demand is increasing, and no later period is expected to be more suitable for expanding the bus service.
questions.promptZh: 乘客需求正在增加，預計稍後不會有比現在更適合擴展巴士服務的時期。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to expand the bus service while passenger demand is increasing.
questions.answerZh: 現在是趁乘客需求增加時擴展巴士服務的最佳時機。
questions.highlight: Now is the best time to expand the bus service while passenger demand is increasing.

questions.prompt: The tourist season begins next month, so the current period is the most suitable for training more staff to handle questions from international visitors.
questions.promptZh: 旅遊旺季將於下個月開始，因此目前最適合培訓更多員工處理國際旅客的查詢。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to train more staff to handle questions from international visitors before the tourist season begins.
questions.answerZh: 現在是旅遊旺季開始前培訓更多員工處理國際旅客查詢的最佳時機。
questions.highlight: Now is the best time to train more staff to handle questions from international visitors before the tourist season begins.

questions.prompt: The school has just received extra funding. This makes the present the most suitable time for improving its online resources for students who study from home.
questions.promptZh: 學校剛剛獲得額外撥款，因此現在是改善網上學習資源，以支援在家學習學生的最合適時候。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to improve the school’s online resources for students who study from home because extra funding has just been received.
questions.answerZh: 由於學校剛剛獲得額外撥款，現在是改善網上資源以支援在家學習學生的最佳時機。
questions.highlight: Now is the best time to improve the school’s online resources for students who study from home because extra funding has just been received.

questions.prompt: The disagreement is still limited, but it may soon become harder to resolve. This creates the ideal moment for bringing the two groups together.
questions.promptZh: 目前的分歧仍然有限，但可能很快變得更難解決。因此，現在是安排兩個群體會面的理想時刻。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to bring the two groups together before the disagreement becomes harder to resolve.
questions.answerZh: 現在是趁分歧變得更難解決前安排兩個群體會面的最佳時機。

questions.prompt: Financial support for cleaner equipment is still available. No later period is likely to be more favourable for investing in cleaner technology.
questions.promptZh: 用於購買更潔淨設備的資助仍然可供申請。稍後未必會有比現在更有利於投資潔淨科技的時期。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to invest in cleaner technology while financial support is still available.

questions.prompt: Several long-term risks have now become clear, while the community still has enough time to respond. This is the most suitable stage for creating a long-term plan.
questions.promptZh: 數項長期風險現已變得清晰，而社區仍有足夠時間作出回應。因此，現在是制訂長遠計劃的最合適階段。
questions.answer: Now is the best time to create a long-term plan because the risks are clear and the community can still respond.

questions.highlight: Now is the best time to create a long-term plan because the risks are clear and the community can still respond.
